Team —

We need to lock down the mid-to-late July bookings that feed into the July-end board packet. Primary asks:

1) Confirm commit/commit-exclude decision for any deals with close dates in the next 30 days. If you list as commit, include the specific evidence item (signed MSA, PO, DocuSign link).
2) For deals we intend to keep as prospect (not commit), add explicit stage and gating reason (e.g., legal redline, procurement PO delay, pricing hold).
3) Upload the ARR evidence pack PDF and the per-deal snapshot (attached xlsx) to the finance Drive link below.

I attached bookings_snapshot_Q3-2027.xlsx and a starter ARR_evidence_pack_StellarMed.pdf that we should edit per-deal. Please reply inline with per-deal bullets so I can assemble the investor narrative.
